# OpenSRM Service Reliability Manifest
# Migrated from legacy NthLayer format
# Original file: batch-reports.yaml
#
# For more information, see:
# https://github.com/rsionnach/opensrm
#

apiVersion: srm/v1
kind: ServiceReliabilityManifest
metadata:
  name: batch-reports
  team: data
  tier: low
spec:
  type: api
  slos:
    report-success-rate:
      type: availability
      target: 95.0
      window: 30d
  dependencies:
  - name: analytics-db
    type: database
    critical: false
  - name: reports-storage
    type: database
    critical: false
  ownership:
    team: data
